info.title: QA Commerce Lab API
info.description: Local training APIs. QA controls intentionally have no authentication. Do not expose this laboratory publicly.

post.description: 202 for new orders; 200 for replay of the same key and request. Prices in USD cents. Poll GET /orders/{orderId} until terminal. Exact JSON request serialization is the idempotency fingerprint; reuse the exact body when retrying.

get.summary: Read own order; another customer receives 404

post.summary: Restore scenario defaults, retain business data

get.summary: Read service health and event processing status

stock.description: Initial seed stock only; current availability is GET /inventory

expectedTotal.description: Client calculated total in cents; mismatch returns 409
